A Gauleiter ( German pronunciation: [ˈɡaʊlaɪtɐ] ⓘ ) was a regional leader of the Nazi Party (NSDAP) who served as the head of a Gau or Reichsgau . Gauleiter was the third-highest rank in the Nazi political leadership , subordinate only to Reichsleiter and to the Führer himself. The position was effectively abolished with the fall of the Nazi regime on 8 May 1945.
